releases.title: Fit shared job text and provide the browser icon
changes: Measure company, role and location in generated share images; retain fitting text and use an explicit word-boundary ellipsis when needed. Preserve salary, fonts, layout and vector star.
Provide the existing orange brand star as a browser icon so the automatic favicon request succeeds. No sounds or new collection.

public.title: Clearer shared job cards
changes: Shared cards keep complete titles when they fit and make shortened text clear.

releases.title: Hosted theme navigation and share-image correction
changes: Make generated theme-page navigation root-relative so hosted pretty URLs preserve Home and board routes.
Render share-image footer stars as vector paths to remove dependence on hosting system font coverage; no sounds or new data collection.

public.title: A smoother trip around the board
changes: Theme links take you to the right place, and shared job cards keep their star.

releases.title: Clearer sign-in and a calmer first visit
changes: Show a compact, theme-aware Latest Update at the initial board shell, once per deliberate announcement with browser acknowledgment; preserve OAuth return tasks and manual-reopen scroll. Add a five-second version welcome note.

Label Google sign-in on mobile and offer a one-time reminder after three newly saved guest applications. Preserve verified QA owner exclusions and surface analytics service configuration failures accurately.
Replace the application nudge with a Tracker sticky note, enlarge mobile bookmarks, compact About Nic, prevent internship stamp overlap and align counts away from doodles.

Remove salary preference from discovery ordering, preserve ordering after feed refresh, update Privacy and Terms, and correct small-text contrast across board and Tracker surfaces. Sound effects remain deferred outside the website.

public.title: A clearer board, from the first visit
changes: Sign-in is easier to find, with a reminder to keep your applications together.
Larger save buttons, a smaller About note and clearer internship cards make phone browsing easier.
The latest updates appear before you start browsing and stay available in Board menu.
Higher pay no longer decides which roles appear first.

releases.title: Keep filter panels above the closed board menu
changes: Fix the closed Board menu stacking layer so its summary cannot cover All Roles or the Filters close button. Add regression coverage for both panels on Jobs and Internships.

public.title: Clearer filters
changes: Board menu stays out of the way when you open filters or choose a role.

releases.title: Readable actions across every theme
changes: Apply links on Jobs now share the readable paper-specific ink already used by internships. Hover underlines preserve contrast. Girlies navigation and Tracker status use matching dark ink; filter counts have a darker readable badge.

public.title: Clearer actions in every theme
changes: Apply links, navigation and filter counts are easier to read, including on pink and dark themes.

releases.title: Keep your place, with clearer internship cards
changes: Preserve account-owned public saved-card snapshots and backfill existing bookmarks from retained retired Jobs rows. Confirm closure only from exact Dead evidence; missing or cross-board saves stay distinct and never disappear silently.

Simplify the internship pay filter and labels, use a stable diverse decorative paper cycle, add full-contrast Internship stamps, enlarge bookmarks and remove redundant Pay Details in job popups while retaining raw source data.

Use one lined help note at a time, remove Tracker help and Google Preferred Sources promotion, move State first, close filters on outside taps, put About Nic in Board menu, open notebook preferences without input focus and remove Clear answers.

Keep newsletter iframe nodes through background refresh, render the form as it arrives, replace external fallback with inline retry; shrink advice art, randomize appropriate open notes, suppress notes in hidden review, and show themed feedback for five seconds with four-second wider toasts.

Exclude the verified QA account from measurement and closure reports. Creator Version 3 experiment stays paused and separate; open-note, Portfolio Graded CTA and Lexend mockups remain private review artifacts.

public.title: Your saved jobs stay with you
changes: Saved listings keep their card details when they leave the board, with a clear note about availability.
Internships have shorter pay labels, varied paper colors and their own stamp. Bookmarks are easier to tap.
Smaller theme previews, clearer menus and quieter notebook popups make browsing easier on your phone.

releases.title: Mobile polish and quieter discovery
changes: Remove feed signup promotions; actual job-detail openings show signup every second time, with a reserved loading state and direct fallback. Every published advice ID has artwork and quieter invitation copy.

Render the real board before current feed resolves, preload local fonts and remove skeleton placeholders. Preserve typed filters, unavailable-feed recovery and no cached catalog. Remove automatic dialog focus outline and correct inherited body font.

Use a one-line tracker reminder after the first and every tenth newly stored application. Top-right tracker removal opens a No-default confirmation with keyboard wrapping and account guards; notes grow without an extra toggle and Export is nearly straight.

Public style guide retains visual brand sections; full prior guide is privately archived. Public HTML and JSON explicitly project two viewer-facing releases while the full ledger remains internal. Privacy describes local cadence counters. Retain Board menu while alternate More placement awaits feedback.

public.title: A little less in your way
changes: A smaller tracker reminder, clearer delete confirmation and notes that grow as you type.
More illustrated advice and fewer newsletter invitations while you browse.
Smoother page loading, cleaner job popups and a shorter visual style guide.

releases.title: A quieter board, clearer pay
changes: Move preferences, hidden jobs, suggestions and what’s new into one Board menu. Preferences open by request; the returning-job introduction is deferred.
Simplify Latest Update, redraw the tracker preview, use white internship paper and keep every arrow drawn.
Use compact whole-number pay labels with exact employer amounts under Pay details, and one list of 50 state names on both boards.
Show one lined-paper tooltip at a time and keep menu and dialog focus predictable.

public.title: A quieter board, clearer pay
changes: Find preferences, hidden jobs, suggestions and what’s new in one Board menu.
Compare shorter pay labels, open Pay details for the original amounts, and filter by one clear list of 50 states.
A simpler Latest Update note gives you more room to explore.

releases.title: Latest Update, with room to settle in
changes: The Latest Update popup waits 30 seconds before opening automatically. Existing dismissals are remembered, and What’s new still opens it immediately.
An Internships card replaces the Portfolio Graded teaser, with a short overview and a direct link to browse internships.

public.title: Internships have a place on the board
changes: Browse internships from the Latest Update note.
The update waits 30 seconds, remembers dismissal, and is always available through What’s new.

releases.title: Keep each account’s place its own
changes: Remember your filters during a short visit and clear them when accounts change. A background refresh keeps navigation in place while current roles are checked.

releases.title: A clearer board, with better recovery
changes: Keep filters through short visits, retry loading without losing your place, and get clearer save and sign-in feedback. Find an optional Prefer us on Google link after Apply, plus a new explanation of how the board works.

releases.title: Keep your place when changing themes
changes: Changing an internship theme keeps you on Internships when you refresh or share the address.

releases.title: A lighter build for the same board
changes: Share-image generation now reuses its drawing canvas so large boards can deploy reliably.
Includes the compact internship cards, short summaries and varied theme paper from 2.2.6.

releases.title: Compact internship cards and clearer summaries
changes: Internship cards show the company, role, exact pay, city and state.
Short TLDR notes put known program dates and key eligibility in the final bullet.
Internships use varied theme paper colors, with more of the strongest accent. Job salary bands stay unchanged.

releases.title: The first internships are on the board
changes: Browse 46 source-checked internships with exact pay, eligibility and application dates.
A separate internship inventory keeps unavailable and held listings out of the board while preserving their review records.
Clearer empty states and program-pay labels, with current internship status checked before hosted listings load.

releases.title: Internship pay and eligibility up front
changes: Internship cards keep exact hourly, monthly and program pay, with the full duties and eligibility in a readable note.
Accepting applications and upcoming programs have separate counts and actions. Announced dates do not automatically open applications.
Internship sharing stays on the internship board, and keyboard focus stays visible inside job details.

releases.title: Preferences without leaving the board
changes: Your preferences now opens as a compact paper pop-up, with a light background blur and clear syncing, saved and retry states.
Optional analytics count preference save, clear and skip actions and not-a-fit responses without collecting typed answers or job identities for those actions.

releases.title: Clearer sign-in and a coffee break
changes: The welcome-back card shows Google with Sign In while signed out, and returns to its close button when signed in.
Replaced the Original theme’s push-up figure with a coffee-break drawing on the board and in the style guide.

releases.title: A welcome that remembers this browser
changes: Dismiss the Version 2 welcome once without signing in; automatic appearances are capped at two, and What’s new remains available.
Open Portfolio Graded inside the welcome for a tier-list example and a coming-soon link.
More Themes uses the same white note paper as the other updates.
Release numbering now pauses before 2.5.0 for a decision on the version format.

releases.title: A board that gets to know your interests
changes: Added optional account preferences, personal job hiding and returning-visitor suggestions on enabled previews.
Opened an internship section with separate review, eligibility and compensation details; its first listings are still being checked.
Added six illustrated lessons about experience during college and expanded drawings across the advice notes.

releases.title: A calmer application routine
changes: Kept Monday clear and moved the calendar cross-out to Friday, alongside Saturday and Sunday.
Reworded the advice as a suggested routine, with a reminder to apply when ready and respect deadlines.

releases.title: The Original stick figures are back
changes: Restored the earlier Original stick figures and matching examples in the style guide.
Kept the other seven themes and gave the first figure room below the board links.

releases.title: Advice notes in the style guide
changes: Open sample advice notes and see how the paper, handwriting and calls to action fit together.
Find guidance for clear promotional labels, everyday wording, photos and the site name, with contents links for quicker browsing.

releases.title: Texture, character and theme feedback
changes: Added texture guides and three matching drawings for every theme, shared with the job board.
Separated optional theme likes and dislikes from theme selections in the analytics dashboard.
Made theme feedback easier to dismiss and kept it out of job detail windows.

releases.title: Quieter notices and a familiar homepage
changes: Replaced the automatic privacy form with a short notice and optional detailed choices.
Restored graduation-photo enlargement within the homepage, without a popup.
Updated the mobile bookmark prompt and made its instructions easier to read.

releases.title: A clearer way back
changes: Shortened the welcome detail action to go back.

releases.title: Your interests, your choices
changes: Optional personalized ordering follows the career fields and roles you explore, with higher disclosed pay among comparable jobs.
Separate analytics and recommendation controls, a history reset, and clearer privacy explanations.
A private owner dashboard summarizes measured activity and answers supported questions.

releases.title: Every theme, with a clearer welcome
changes: Explore all eight themes in the style guide, now linked from Version History.
A roomier Version 2 welcome puts the tracker first and gives each feature one clear way back.
Optional Google sign-in in the application feedback note keeps your unanswered question through sign-in.

releases.title: Back to the notebook
changes: Shared warm yellow, handwritten welcome and suggestion notes, a visual style guide, and a shorter mobile bookmark reminder.
Featured job cards follow salary bands, with clearer action text.

releases.title: Meet Version 2
changes: A welcome on your first Jobs visit introduces advice, themes, Google sync and Tracker, plus a Portfolio Graded preview.
A tighter homepage, Apply to Jobs beside Nic’s signature, and easier access to Bookmark and Suggest Jobs.
Version history is available from the founder note, board footer and welcome.
Six additional verified job URL variants now group into their original postings.

releases.title: The new board
changes: Saved jobs and applications sync across devices with Google sign-in.
Clearer navigation and mobile controls.
One card per recognized job posting, with existing saved links preserved.
Search and filter across all 14 job categories.
A roomier desktop homepage, clearer bookmark shortcut and clickable graduation photo.
Restored founder notes and clearer Sign In and Signed In labels.
Suggest Jobs sends links to a private review inbox before any publishing decision.
Version history now lives beside the homepage footer links.
